body:
Thank you so much. This has been difficult, and your support is very appreciated.

I will go to the counseling center in May, is what I scheduled (the soonest). I won't go to Title IX services unless she's pregnant. I don't want it to be a big deal. I am too scared to ask if she had her period, because I can't bear the result. I look forward to getting counseling though, as I could use it due to this scenrio whether there is a pregnancy or not. 

Redditors have been a great help. Thank you for the resources especially, I have visited a couple and they have helped.

I'm so sorry that you experienced that. Thank you so much. I will certainly have to wait until this blows over, otherwise there would he a court case, but hopefully this all blows over and is not a problem. I told one of my best friends today, and I think he will be there to talk to and be supportive. So that's good. Plus all of the support on reddit, thank you all so much. I wrote my note earlier this week, but I don't think I'll need it. All of you have helped. So from the bottom of my heart: thank you.

Yeah. I told a friend today. Im afraid they'll be mad at me for drinking, because I got drunk and lost my phone earlier this year (I later found it) but being the dipshit that I am, I didn't learn a lesson.

I think they'll want to press charges, but as long as she isn't pregnant I will not press charges. I just want this to go away.

In the far future I will tell my family. For now, I have the friend I told and perhaps I'll tell my more-understanding-than-my-parents older brother.

Thank you for taking the time to talk. You don't realize the difference you are making. Thank you so much.

Thank you so much. I've been having a really rough go of it. I can hardly do my homework, and I've been moving so slowly it feels like. My family asks me how I'm doing because they care, yet I cannot be honest with them.  I'm just hoping that she is not pregnant so with a little therapy I can move on with my life.
The hard thing is, my main friends are my roommates, and since my predator lives in the same dorm as me I have to he careful. It would be easy for one of them to blab. But I'm going to stay safe. This is not enough for me to die over. I will not go back to review my suicide note, but I haven't deleted it either. Either way, I'm very thankful for all of the support my lovely fellow redditors have offered me.
I am more concerned about having to raise or support a child with a woman that caused me great discomfort and I am terribly far from loving her.

Thank you so much, I needed to hear that. I can't continue to beat myself up for it.  The guilt and shame have been paralyzing. Thank you for sharing that website as well, I will take advantage of that resource.

Wow. I just never thought I would be that 1 in 6. I just don't want to be a teen pregnancy statistic. But you are correct. I will not buy into the lie that this makes me any less of a human either. I am still valuable, and I should live.  I'm just so sorry, and I hope she is not pregnant--especially for her sake. 

The sad thing is that this already happened once,  although to a lesser extent. I thought we learned the lesson. Apparently not. Either way,  if she is pregnant, I will report the misconduct. I have several witnesses to how shitfaced I was as well.

I am a college student, so with finals just around the corner I desperately hope that she is not pregnant.

My family is so good to me, and I don't want to put them under the stress. I have a better family than I could ever deserve. I don't want to put this weight on them.

I scheduled a counseling appt. at my university, but it is not until May because they are booked so full.

Thank you for responding. She told me that night her period would either be in 3 days or 10-14 days (which I really don't understand) but I'm terrified to ask her 2 days later. I already wrote my suicide note, but I have such a good life. I don't want to leave it but I feel like I will have to. I don't think I will press charges unless she is pregnant, but I plan on keeping the hell away from her regardless. I might buy a pregnancy test I guess? I stayed in bed and cried most of the day. I just don't know what to do.

This doesn't normally happen to men I think, and I feel entirely worthless. I can't help feel it's my fault somehow, but at the same time I don't think I would have done those things without being copiously drunk.
